Only when the user requests application development, the previously saved application environment notes below apply:

This is a static Korean marketing website at /workspace/kottomkt. Use the existing checkout; cloud tasks are already isolated. Do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. There is no package manifest, build, dependency installation, database, or required secret for local development. Keep tracked source and lockfiles unchanged during environment setup.
